about: The rules every PEA gateway must follow. gateway.py reads this file when it starts and the Mac app embeds it at build time, so neither keeps its own copy. Change it only together with the conformance tests.

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://accounts.google.com/gsi/client; style-src 'self' https://accounts.google.com/gsi/style; img-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' https://api.open-meteo.com https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com https://openrouter.ai https://api.github.com https://accounts.google.com https://www.googleapis.com https://docs.googleapis.com https://forms.googleapis.com https://gptkiosk.github.io; frame-src https://accounts.google.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

reminders.about: POST replaces the whole list of reminders a gateway may show as system notifications; GET says whether it can show any. A gateway that cannot show notifications checks the list the same way and answers that it is not available.

reader.about: POST {"url"} asks the gateway to read one public web page for the owner, who has approved that exact address in the page, or one file of a curated catalog whose address the owner approved there. It is not a proxy: one GET over HTTPS on port 443 to a named public host, no credentials, no redirects followed, text only, bounded. The host's every resolved address must be outside refusedNetworks, and the connection goes to an address that was checked.
reader.userAgent: PEA-reader/1 (reads one page its owner approved)
reader.accept: text/html, text/plain;q=0.9, application/xhtml+xml;q=0.8, application/rss+xml;q=0.7, application/atom+xml;q=0.7, application/xml;q=0.6, text/xml;q=0.6, application/json;q=0.5

speech.about: POST path {provider, key, voice, text} turns text the owner reviewed into speech with the owner's own key at one named provider; POST voicesPath {provider, key} lists that key's voices. It is not a proxy: one fixed HTTPS request to the provider's own host on port 443 with its certificate checked, no redirects followed, bounded in time and size. The key is used for that one request and is never kept or logged, and the provider's own words are never passed on.

search.about: POST path {provider, key, query} asks one named search provider one question with the owner's own key, after the owner reviewed the exact words in the page. It is not a proxy: one fixed HTTPS request to the provider's own host on port 443 with its certificate checked, no redirects followed, bounded in time and size. Nothing in a request chooses the host, the path or any option. The key is used for that one request and is never kept or logged, and the provider's own error words are never passed on. It shares the one provider slot with speech: one such request at a time.
search.userAgent: PEA-Gateway/1 (asks one search its owner approved)

updates.about: GET path says whether this gateway can update its own installed copy and what happened last time. POST path {"action":"check"} looks for an update; POST path {"action":"apply","commit"} installs exactly the commit the owner reviewed. Only a gateway its operator started with an installed checkout and service named can do either; any other answers that it is not available. Nothing in a request chooses the checkout, the channel, the service or the source of the update.
updates.unavailable: Updating from the app is not set up for this PEA.

projects.about: GET path says whether this gateway is connected to the owner's project engine (MCD) on this machine. POST path {"action", ...} asks it one of the named things: list its templates, list or read the owner's projects, read a project's progress, or leave a draft of a project the owner reviewed. The engine is MCD or RCD: both answer the same way. It is not a proxy: one fixed POST to upstreamPath at the one address the operator set at start (plain HTTP to a loopback address on this machine, or HTTPS with its certificate checked to a host the operator named, such as an engine on their private network), with a credential read from a private file the operator named, no redirects followed, bounded in time and size. A draft starts nothing: planning, approval, spending and every run are decided in the engine's own pages. Nothing in a request chooses the address, the path, the credential or a working folder, the credential never reaches the page, and the engine's own error words are never passed on.
projects.unavailable: Projects are not connected for this PEA.

refusals.refused: The project engine did not accept this PEA's access. Review it in the engine.
refusals.declined: The project engine did not accept that request. Nothing was changed.
refusals.failed: The project engine could not be reached or gave an answer PEA does not accept. No retry.
